title: ETC-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluation-Side Transcript Canonicalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Written transcripts of the same speech can differ in ways that are not uniquely determined by the speech signal. We formulate evaluation-side transcript canonicalization (ETC), which maps multiple surface forms to a single canonical form when their differences are not determined by speech. To our knowledge, ETC-Bench is the first and most comprehensive multilingual benchmark for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization, covering 181 phenomenon types across 12 languages. Each instance is a minimal pair that shares a sentence context and differs only in a target span exhibiting one phenomenon. To evaluate both canonicalization success and semantic preservation, we propose Semantic-preserving Exact-match Normalization Accuracy (SENA), which combines exact agreement between independently canonicalized pair members with a pair-relative BERTScore constraint against information loss. translated_title: ETC-Bench：面向评估侧转录文本规范化的多语言基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36527v1 公告类型：new 摘要：同一语音的书面转录文本之间可能存在并非由语音信号唯一决定的差异。我们提出了评估侧转录文本规范化（ETC）的概念，即当多种表面形式之间的差异不受语音决定时，将其映射为单一的规范形式。据我们所知，ETC-Bench 是首个也是最全面的面向评估侧转录文本规范化的多语言基准，涵盖 12 种语言中的 181 种现象类型。每个实例都是一个最小对立对，即共享相同的句子上下文，仅在体现某一现象的目标片段上有所不同。为了同时评估规范化的成功与否和语义保留程度，我们提出了语义保持的精确匹配规范化准确率（SENA），该指标将独立规范化后两个对成员之间的精确一致性与防止信息丢失的对相对 BERTScore 约束相结合。我们进一步引入了分类法引导的智能体规范化器……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了 ETC-Bench，这是首个覆盖 12 种语言、181 种现象类型的最全面的评估侧转录文本规范化多语言基准，并提出了兼顾规范化准确性与语义保持的 SENA 评估指标。
